zh: 新增宠物声音：聊天宠物在完成与出错时刻播放一声短音，每个时刻可选内置的「风铃」「叮」、关闭或自己的音频文件（MP3/WAV/OGG/M4A，不超过 5 MB），设置页可试听与上传；文件按事件存进宿主半边，版本化地址随字节更换。
en: Add pet sounds: the chat pet plays a short note on completion and error moments; each moment picks a bundled chime or ding, off, or the reader's own audio file (MP3/WAV/OGG/M4A, up to 5 MB), with preview and upload in settings; files live in the host half under a versioned address.
